description.value: A family winery set on 13 acres of pastoral farmland alongside the Serpentine River on the edge of White Rock. They produce a range of wines including Merlot, Cabernet blends, Gewürztraminer, Rosé, and a late harvest red, all available for tasting and purchase on-site. The rural setting and vineyard grounds make it an appealing rest stop for cyclists riding the flat agricultural roads of south Surrey.
